description: 40+ categorized Instagram caption templates with fill-in-the-blank fields.

faqs.a: Pick a category, choose a template, fill in the [blanks], and click Fill to get your finished caption.
faqs.q: How do I use a template?

faqs.a: Motivational, funny, travel, food, selfies, business, love, fitness, and more — over 40 templates total.
Square brackets [like this] mark the blanks. Type your words into the field for each blank.
Click Copy Caption to copy the finished caption with hashtags, ready to paste into Instagram.
faqs.q: How do I copy the result?

howto: Choose a template from the list.
Fill in each [blank] with your own words.
title: Instagram Caption Templates
